podcast.title: Car Collector
podcast.body: Guy Barryman, the bassist for Coldplay, possesses an impressive and extensive collection of cars. His collection features a variety of vehicles, ranging from classic Porsches to a Bugatti Veyron. "Guy Barryman of Coldplay has an incredible collection of cars, ranging from classic porches to a Bugatti Veyron."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Car Collector and Racer
podcast.body: Guy Berryman of Coldplay is a collector of expensive cars and enjoys racing them. "Guy Barryman of Colt Play has a collector of expensive cars and likes to race."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Car Racing and Collection
xref.body: Guy Berryman, Coldplay's bassist, occasionally races cars under an assumed name. His collection of road cars, comprising about 25 vehicles, features a mix of vintage and new models. This includes a Bugatti Veyron (retailing for over $3 million), a Lamborghini Aventador (worth approximately $1 million), a Ferrari F40, a McLaren F1 (valued around $25 million), and several Porsches. "He has a Bugatti Veyron, which retails for well beyond $3 million. A Lamborghini Aventador, good for about a million, a Ferrari F40, a McLaren F1, which, about $25 million for one of those, and a couple of porches, about 25 cars in total."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Extensive Car Collection from Music Success
xref.body: As the bass player for Coldplay, Guy Berryman has amassed a significant car collection, reported to be around 25 vehicles. His infatuation with cars began in childhood. His collection includes a unique 1957 Porsche 356-Carrera Speedster built for a French racing driver, a Bugatti Veyron (once the fastest production car at nearly 430 km/h), Ferraris, Lamborghinis, Lancias, and Alpines. He occasionally races these cars on the track, which is financially feasible due to Coldplay's success with tens of millions of albums sold, billions of streams, and equally divided royalties. "As the bass player for Coldplay, the music business has been very, very good to Guy Barryman."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Formation at University College London
xref.body: Coldplay was formed when Chris Martin met his future bandmates, Johnny Buckland, Guy Berryman, and Will Champion, while attending University College London. This meeting marked the foundational moment for the band. "The big break came when he entered University College, London, where he met cold play bandmates Johnny Buckland, Guy Berryman, and Will Champion."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Formation of Coldplay at University
xref.body: Chris Martin's significant career break occurred when he enrolled at University College London, where he met his future Coldplay bandmates: Johnny Buckland, Guy Berryman, and Will Champion. This meeting was pivotal in the formation of one of the most commercially successful piano-based alt rock bands. "The big break came when he entered University College, London, where he met cold play bandmates Johnny Buckland, Guy Berryman, and Will Champion."
